verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, and in-product AI insights are a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only rule-based automation (auto-transfers, real-time expense categorization, approval rules) and an llms.txt file for external LLMs. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
